def test_fizz_buzz():

    assert fizz_buzz(50) == 0
    assert fizz_buzz(78) == 2   # 77 -> "77" contributes two 7s

    assert fizz_buzz(1) == 0    # only 0 qualifies -> "0"
    assert fizz_buzz(11) == 0   # 0 -> "0"
    assert fizz_buzz(12) == 0   # 0, 11 -> "011"
    assert fizz_buzz(77) == 0   # multiples below 77 contain no digit 7
    assert fizz_buzz(100) == 3  # 77 (two 7s) + 78 (one 7)
    assert fizz_buzz(118) == 4  # 77 (2) + 78 (1) + 117 = 9*13 (1)
    assert fizz_buzz(-5) == 0   # negative range is empty
